name: Closeology claims API
update: Rebuilt daily from each jurisdiction's public registry.
attribution: Claims data: Canadian provincial/territorial mineral tenure registries (see jurisdictions.json for each source), compiled by Closeology. Always verify a claim in the official registry before staking or transacting.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Claim / tenure number as issued by the jurisdiction (unique within a jurisdiction).

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: Province/territory code: AB BC MB NB NL NS NT NU ON QC SK YT.

fields.name: holder
fields.description: Registered holder(s) as published by the source, incl. % interest where given. Empty if not published.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Claim or property name. Empty if not published.

fields.name: issued
fields.description: Issue / staking / recording date, YYYY-MM-DD. Empty if not published.

fields.name: expiry
fields.description: Good-to, term-end or anniversary date (see jurisdictions.json expiry_kind), YYYY-MM-DD. Empty if not published.

fields.name: area_ha
fields.description: Area in hectares (source value, else computed in EPSG:3978).

fields.name: bbox
fields.description: [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat] of the claim polygon (WGS84).

fields.name: tile
fields.description: GeoJSON tile key ix_iy holding the claim's representative point (0.5-degree grid).

fields.name: record_url
fields.description: Link to the official registry record, where the jurisdiction has one.

vector_tiles.format: PMTiles v3 (Mapbox Vector Tiles), EPSG:3857, served with HTTP range requests

layers.claims: claim polygons, z9-11 (clients overzoom beyond); every claim kept at every zoom. Properties: id, jurisdiction, holder, name, issued, expiry, area_ha (empty ones omitted). record_url = jurisdictions.json record_url_template
layers.coverage: one point per ~5 km cell with staked ground, z0-8; property n = number of claims

geojson_tiles.scheme: ix = floor(lon / 0.5), iy = floor(lat / 0.5); WGS84 polygons. Only keys listed in index.json 'tiles' exist. A claim crossing a tile edge appears in each tile it touches.

claim_lookup.shard: fnv1a32(utf8(id)) % lookup_shards  (lookup_shards per jurisdiction in jurisdictions.json)
claim_lookup.returns: object keyed by claim id -> {holder, name, issued, expiry, area_ha, lon, lat, bbox}; empty fields omitted. jurisdiction = the path; tile = floor(lon/0.5)_floor(lat/0.5); record_url = jurisdictions.json record_url_template with {id}. closeology-claims.js getClaim() returns the full record.
